name: v1.9.6
body:
# NoorNote 1.9.6

- New Feedback Board: a public Kanban board between you and the developer — file feedback, follow progress, get a DM on every update.
- Music track & playlist cards, plus interactive 3D object notes.
- More reliable quoted notes and relay connections on long sessions.
- Fixes: Bookmarks unread count, false "unknown DM" warnings, quote spacing.

name: v1.9.5
body:
# Release Notes 1.9.5

## New

- **Badge definitions (NIP-58):** badges on Nostr now resolve to their real name, description and image.

## Fixed

- Comment threads now show all nested replies (previously only top-level comments appeared).
- Quotes inside reposts load reliably — slow relays no longer leave "Quote could not be loaded" behind.
- Two wrong German labels fixed: the posting toast no longer says "Highlight posten" while waiting for signer approval.

name: v1.9.4
body:
# Release Notes 1.9.4

## New

- **The global Back button can be switched off**: if the button at the bottom edge bothers you, disable it in Settings → Interface. Default stays on — nothing changes unless you touch the switch.

## Improved

- More breathing room at the bottom of content views (40 → 48 px), including the article editor, which previously ended flush at the edge.

## Fixed in 1.9.4

- The reply composer's timeline switch showed a wrong German label ("Neues Highlight").

## Under the hood

- Build hygiene: silenced Sass deprecation warnings, shared error-message helper, new profile-load regression tests.

name: v1.9.3
body:
# Release Notes 1.9.3

## New

- **NoorNote speaks German**: switch the entire UI to German in Settings → Interface. English stays the default until you choose — nothing changes on its own.
- **Local full-text search**: search your notes and DMs instantly, entirely on your device. Optional "only local caches" mode in the search spotlight.

## Improved

- Profiles without posts load instantly instead of waiting on relays.

## Fixed in 1.9.3

- Dropdowns, menus and toasts are readable again (transparent-glass regression from 1.9.2).
- Profiles no longer show a false "No events found" while relays are still loading.
- GIF search on desktop.
- Notes with manipulated future timestamps can no longer jump to the top of your feeds.

## Under the hood

- Electron 44 (security backports), Vite 8, faster feed internals — and the groundwork for community translations.

name: v1.9.1
body:
# Release Notes 1.9.1

## New

- **Show reactions in your timeline** (optional): see reactions from people you follow as feed entries — enable globally in settings or per user on their profile. Off by default.

## Improved

- **Reposts respond instantly**: the icon colors right away instead of after several seconds. Double-click no longer creates duplicate reposts, and taking a repost back works reliably.

## Fixed

- Booking RSVPs now reliably reach event owners whose relays don't overlap with yours.

name: v1.9.0
body:
# v1.9.0

## New
- Recipes on Nostr: publish recipes from the article editor, open shared recipe packs as cards, and browse recipes from your follows in a new side-column tab
- NIP-5A websites (nsites) fully supported — including a Websites grid on profiles

## Improved
- Smarter relay handling: respects relay rate limits, fewer disconnects and reconnect storms
- Android: `nostr:` links can now open directly in NoorNote

## Fixed
- Unknown event types show a useful card with actions instead of a dead end

name: v1.8.3
body:
# v1.8.3

## New
- GIF picker in the composer — search and post GIFs from nostr.build, on all platforms
- NIP-71 video support: video posts now display in feed, profiles, quotes and notifications

## Fixed
- Own web comments no longer duplicate in profile and tribe feeds after refresh

name: v1.8.2
body:
# 1.8.2

- New: Daily Quran ayah — one ayah per day in the Nostr Majlis sidebar widget (Arabic + English), with the full English tafsir in the new "Daily Ayah" tab
- New: Sidebar widgets are clickable — Wallet Balance, BTC Price and Nostr Majlis jump straight to their pages
- Fixed: Custom emojis now render in the composer preview, and previews no longer go stale
- Fixed: Notification reply threading, account switcher overflow, and the back bar no longer overlaps content on settings and addon pages

name: v1.8.1
body:
# NoorNote 1.8.1

**Design — Marble Glass.** A new translucent glass background for modals, dropdowns, the search spotlight, toasts and tooltips, plus translucent buttons and slim lilac scrollbars. Soft fade-and-scale entrances for modals and menus, gentle cross-fade view transitions.

**Navigation.** New global back button in a slim glass bar at the bottom of the main pane — back works everywhere, stays in sync with your browser's back button and survives cold deep links.

**New theme: T-Low.** The classic pre-1.8.0 Soft Lilac palette is back under its own name.

**Follow Packs.** Owners can now share a pack to their own timeline with one click — from the pack card and from the pack detail view.

**Welcome page.** The interstitial banners now follow your selected theme.

Plus: search spotlight closes on outside clicks, quieter sidebar widgets and ISL actions, transparent poll creator, and a single-row quote error layout.

name: v1.8.0
body:
# NoorNote 1.8.0

**New Navigation** — The sidebar menu is now a circular wheel around the NoorNote logo. Prefer the old list? Switch it back in Settings → UI ("Classic Menu"). Lists now live on their own overview page, and unread bookmarks show as a green badge.

**Sidebar Widgets** — Wallet Balance and BTC Price widgets now share one clean look: sats/crypto left, fiat right, matching icons and typography across all themes.

**Themes** — Soft Lilac got a full recolor (warm beige + rose), and all sidebar widgets follow your theme's colors exactly.

**Fixes** — Collapsed sidebar shows the familiar icon rail again; Search moved to the sidebar top, Download to the footer.

name: v1.7.0
body:
# NoorNote 1.7.0

## New: Appointment booking
Let people book time with you: configure your weekly availability in the Calendar addon and share your booking page — guests pick a free slot, you get a DM, cancellations keep everyone informed.

## New: Calendar import/export & reset
Import Google Calendar or any .ics file (with preview and range filter), export your whole calendar as .ics, and reset your calendar locally with a single publishable wipe.

## Fixes
- Web: NWC wallet survives IndexedDB eviction (no more lost wallet connection)
- Links containing npubs no longer trigger false mentions

name: v1.6.1
body:
# NoorNote 1.6.1

## New: Addons overview page
The "Addons" sidebar entry now opens a clean tile overview of all addons instead of a long submenu — with descriptions, an active/inactive LED and "New"/"Updated" badges. Reorder tiles by drag & drop or with the ▲▼ buttons; the order is saved per account and can be reset anytime.

## Fixes
- Fixed broken note rendering for links that contain an naddr in the URL (false "Satellite Earth" cards and garbled link text)
- URLs containing npubs are no longer mangled by mention detection

name: v1.6.0
body:
# NoorNote 1.6.0

## New: Calendar addon
Your personal calendar on Nostr: month, week and list views, public and private (encrypted) events, reminders — and you can subscribe to other people's public event calendars with one click.

## New: Centralized reminders
Calendar, notes and prayer reminders now share one notification system — including proper Android notifications that fire even when the app is closed.

## New: "Share in TL"
Share any of your calendar events (or events you follow) into your timeline with one click — they render as interactive event cards.

## Fixes
- Fixed nostr.build media upload failures (CORS errors)
- Fixed calendar event deletion not sticking on all relays
- Calendar reminder dismissals now stick across app restarts

name: v1.5.5
body:
# NoorNote 1.5.5

**React and reply to zaps** — zap receipts now show their own reaction line, and the zap pill opens a menu: react with any emoji (❤️) or reply to the zapper. Zap-reaction notifications link straight to the zapped note.

**Web updates announce themselves** — when a new version is live on noornote.app, a notice with a reload button appears in the sidebar.

name: v1.5.4
body:
# NoorNote 1.5.4

**Prayer reminders clean up after themselves** — prayer notifications vanish 10 min after the prayer time, holiday reminders after 3 hours, on all platforms. No more notification pile-ups on your phone.

**Taken-back interactions disappear for real** — if an author deletes a like, repost, quote, reply or zap, it is now removed from your stats, timelines and likes lists too. Own likes show up instantly in the likes list.

name: v1.5.3
body:
# Release Notes 1.5.3 (Compact)

## New

- Share Note / Share article: share links now open in a slim modal with one-tap copy — article links open the article view directly

## Improved

- Repo announcements and Satellite Earth site settings render properly instead of "unsupported"
- Unread bookmark markers respect your read-sync setting

name: v1.5.2
body:
# NoorNote 1.5.2

**New** — Unread bookmark counter in the sidebar: bookmark posts to read them later, and the counter ticks down as you open them — so you never forget one. Optional encrypted cross-device sync in the bookmark addon settings (with frequency selector), plus a "Mark as read" button and a reset. Unread bookmarks show a subtle mint border until opened. You can now take back likes and reposts — just click the icon again. New BTC Price addon with sidebar widget.

**Improved** — Podcast cards look cleaner: boost link and zap receipt now live in one card, styled on the shared card design. Bitcoin rates load Kraken-first with more reliable fallbacks and a manual refresh in the BTC widget.

**Fixes** — Zap button payment checks hardened; BTC widget description cleaned up; assorted stability fixes.

name: v1.5.1
body:
# NoorNote 1.5.1

**New** — Own zaps appear instantly; gated premium notes show a clean unlock card; quoted repost chains cap at 3 levels with a clean "open" placeholder; live zaps and likes now work on long-form articles.

**Performance** — Posting and replying feel snappier; timeline refreshes and mute/NSFW toggles rebuild instantly instead of re-rendering everything; load-more pages in faster; reply/like counters fill in all at once; login is smoother with fewer background requests; mini avatars load lazily as you scroll.

**Reliability** — Feeds recover automatically after sleep, network switches or long background stays — no more empty timeline after opening the lid. Posts that fail (offline, relay outage) are queued and delivered automatically once you're back — with their original timestamp. Gaps after long absences are caught up completely instead of silently skipped. Reaction flicker on double-tap is gone; long sessions no longer accumulate slowdowns.

**Fixes** — Comment nesting in threads, dropdown positioning in multi-line textareas, plus assorted stability fixes.

name: v1.4.1
body:
# NoorNote 1.4.1

New in this version:

📖 **EPUB Reader** — Books shared in notes open directly in NoorNote: paginated reading view with table of contents, reading progress, and automatic resume. Downloads still available for every book.

🎙 **Podcast Episodes** — Podcast episodes (kind 30054) render as cards with cover art, duration and a built-in audio player.

⚡ **Live Interactions** — While a note is open, new reactions, zaps, quoted reposts and replies appear instantly — no reload needed.

🔗 **Profile Bio Links** — `nevent1…` / `note1…` references in profile descriptions are now tappable links that open the note.

Fixes & polish:

- Wallet balance: fiat conversion works reliably again (new Kraken rate fallback) + currency selector directly on the Wallet Balance addon page.
- Addons sidebar: "(reset order)" link no longer shows up without a real custom order; move dropdown no longer overflows the screen edge.
- Noor Jadid theme: brighter accents for better readability.

name: v1.4.0
body:
# NoorNote 1.4.0

**New: Analytics** — Your personal Nostr stats: posts, replies, follows, content, zaps and engagement. Includes your Top 10 posts and engagement/zap diagrams over time. Relay-friendly, cached per account, refreshed incrementally.

**New** — "Read more from this author" on articles. NIP-29 group chat messages now render as readable cards with notification previews.

**Improved** — Faster article feed loads (cached social graph). Addons menu: initial order is alphabetical, with a "(reset order)" link after customizing.

**Fixed** — Infinite scroll prefetch, dead "Load more" in tribe timelines, false unread-DM toasts after login. Copied event IDs and share links now carry relay hints.

**Renamed** — "External quotes" is now called "Highlights".

**Under the hood** — Big stability and quality pass: the whole codebase was cleaned to zero lint warnings (now enforced on every build) and covered by a growing automated test suite — fewer regressions, more reliable updates.

name: v1.3.6
body:
# NoorNote 1.3.6

**New** — user statuses on profiles (NIP-38): see someone's one-liner under their NIP-05, set your own by clicking it.

**New** — classified listings (NIP-99) now display everywhere in the app; the marketplace addon is only needed to buy & sell.

**Improved** — private petname notes now show in warning orange: filled note icon plus an orange avatar ring, everywhere.

**Fixed** — long single-block draft text scrolls sideways so the delete button stays reachable.

name: v1.3.5
body:
# NoorNote 1.3.5

**Improved** — long notes (shopping lists, checklists) now show a "See more" button on the card that expands them to full length — no more cut-off content.

**Fixed** — the Armada invite-link input and Add button sit properly on one row again.

name: v1.3.4
body:
# NoorNote 1.3.4

**New: Armada communities (Group Chats addon)** — join encrypted Armada/Concord communities via invite links, see them listed in settings, and get notified about new activity.

**New: Hide external quote posts** — turn off those "quote every paragraph of a web article" highlight posts globally (Settings → UI) or per user (profile → "Turn off ext. Quotes"). Reposts of them are hidden too; your own highlights stay visible.

**Improved** — profiles now resolve reliably (no more "@npub…" placeholders or "Anonymous" profiles), and the Soft Mute button in profiles works again.

name: v1.3.3
body:
# What's new in NoorNote v1.3.3

🐞 **Diagnostics for everyone** — diagnostic logs now work on Web too. Crash capture, list sync traces, relay pool snapshots — all recorded and exportable from Settings or the new SCC button.

📊 **One-tap log export on Desktop & Web** — a small "Export DiagLogs" button in the secondary-content tab strip, right next to the System Log. APK users keep the existing Settings button.

name: v1.3.2
body:
# What's new in NoorNote v1.3.2

📰 **Smarter Articles** — your article feed now pulls from your friend-of-a-friend network instead of a flat global list.

🔕 **No more toast spam** — a replayed message backlog no longer stacks a wall of "unknown sender" toasts.

📱 **Android log export fixed** — exporting logs from Settings no longer crashes the app.

name: v1.3.1
body:
# What's new in NoorNote v1.3.1

🖼️ **Less spam in Articles** — the global article feed now filters out articles without a cover image.

💬 **Disappearing DMs** — set a self-destruct timer on a conversation.

✨ **Smoother onboarding** — new accounts get working DM relays out of the box.

🔔 **Better repost notifications** — reposted articles now open in the article reader.

name: v1.3.0
body:
# NoorNote 1.3.0

- **Live streams in your feed:** NIP-53 live activities now render as proper live cards across the timeline, notes, reposts, bookmarks and notifications.
- **Tag people in images (NIP-68):** add user tags to images with a chip composer; tagged users get notified.
- **Soft mute:** silence a user's notifications (replies, reactions, zaps on your notes) without hiding their posts, profile or replies anywhere else, synced via NIP-78.
- **Better messages & zaps:** a toast now alerts you to DMs from people you don't follow, and zaps carry a badge that opens their reply thread.
- **Relay insights + fixes:** the analytics modal shows which relays a note was seen on; Follow Pack reposts/quotes now render the full card, the extended-follows toggle no longer sticks off before login, and wallet storage is more resilient.

name: v1.2.8
body:
# NoorNote 1.2.8

- **Nostrord group notifications fixed:** posts in your groups no longer get missed when a relay is slow. You can now optionally be alerted about your own posts too, and tapping a notification opens the group in the Nostrord web client.
- **Smoother side-column tabs:** the secondary column now has a clickable home tab, and stray tabs clean up correctly when you resize the window.
